steps.text: Eight planets travel around the Sun. Mercury is closest, then Venus, then Earth, then Mars.
Which planet is third from the Sun?
steps.hint: Count Mercury, Venus, then the next one.

steps.text: Yes, Earth is third. That distance gives us the right amount of light and heat for water and life.
Let us count outwards: Mercury first, Venus second, Earth third, Mars fourth. Earth is the third planet.
After Mars come Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Jupiter is the largest of them all.
Great work! You know the order of the planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
